turns.text: Who can participate in the ABDM Sandbox?

must_contain: a company, firm or other entity incorporated or licensed to operate in India can participate
the entity must be able to comply with data privacy and consumer protection regulations
the entity must have safeguards against unauthorized access to records and data
notes: catalogue gap: the sandbox entity eligibility criteria, company type, compliance and safeguard requirements, are not documented. NHA's own pages disagree on who can participate: this case requires the entity-eligibility answer, while faq-verbatim-sandbox-m1-02 requires 'any entity or individual can potentially participate' and faq-verbatim-abdm-sandbox-15 requires that citizens and healthcare professionals do not register directly. The conflict is NHA's, across its own pages, not ours.
